race.comment: BIG KAPOW (1) has the strongest exposed profile, coming off a fourth at Sale where he was beaten just under two lengths and was again respected near the top of betting. Backs up quickly and should go close. WEASEL SEA (5) is the most reliable place-getter in the race, with seven placings from seven starts and three this campaign, but he still has to convert that consistency into a maiden win. LIFE'S UNCERTAINTY (7) debuts for a stable with a solid local profile and has had four trials, including a Mornington trial win earlier in October. Son of Doubtland with a $110,000 yearling tag. Could kick off with a win. LADY OF LUBECK (13) returns off with a good Flemington trial and wasn't far away at the maiden campaign. Keep safe fresh.
